def activation_count(model: nn.Module, inputs: Tuple[Any, ...],
    supported_ops: Optional[Dict[str, Handle]]=None) ->Tuple[DefaultDict[
    str, float], Counter[str]]:
    activation_counter = ActivationCountAnalysis(model, inputs)
    if supported_ops is not None:
        activation_counter.set_op_handle(**supported_ops)
    activation_counter.unsupported_ops_warnings(False)
    activation_counter.uncalled_modules_warnings(False)
    by_operator = activation_counter.by_operator()
    total_activation_params = defaultdict(float)
    for op, count in by_operator.items():
        total_activation_params[op] = count / 1e6
    return total_activation_params, activation_counter.unsupported_ops()
